name: Fortune Telling
overview: Scripture firmly condemns fortune telling and related practices such as witchcraft, enchantment, and consulting familiar spirits, viewing them as defilement and rebellion against God. The Lord commands His people not to seek out wizards or those with familiar spirits, warning that such actions provoke His judgment and can lead to severe consequences, including death (Exodus 22:18; Leviticus 19:31, 20:6, 20:27). Additionally, Scripture cautions against observing times or celestial bodies for guidance, emphasizing that worship or reliance on anything other than God is idolatry (Leviticus 19:26; Deuteronomy 4:19). These passages underscore the exclusive lordship of God and call believers to trust Him alone rather than occult practices.
